description: Look up a VA form by number (e.g. 21-526EZ, 22-1990, 26-1880, SF-180, DD-293). Returns title, plain-English description, who-files-it, download URL, and next steps (where to get free filing help). Without form_number, returns the full catalog of 22 most-needed forms.

category.description: Optional category filter when listing forms

form_number.description: Optional VA form number — e.g. "21-526EZ", "22-1990", "SF-180". Omit to list all.

name: lookup_va_form
title: Look up a VA form
